career_ladder.note: Career progression in the Rajasthan Administrative Service (RAS) starts from direct recruitment to the State Service Junior Scale, advancing through Senior Scale, Selection Scale, and Super Time Scale (STS). Meritorious and senior RAS officers are inducted into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) cadre under the IAS (Appointment by Promotion) Regulations, enabling progression to apex administrative assignments such as District Collector, Divisional Commissioner, and Principal Secretary to the State Government.

exam_scheme.note: The Rajasthan State and Subordinate Services Combined Competitive Examination is conducted in three stages: Preliminary Examination (200 marks, objective, screening only), Main Written Examination (800 marks, four compulsory descriptive papers of 200 marks each), and Personality & Viva-Voce Examination (100 marks). Final merit order is calculated strictly on the aggregate of Main Examination and Personality Test (900 marks total).

stages.source_label: RPSC Scheme and Syllabus for Rajasthan State and Subordinate Services Comb. Comp. (Preliminary) Examination

papers.negative_marking: 1/3 mark deducted per wrong answer (0.44 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Screening cut-off set by RPSC to shortlist approx. 15 times the number of vacancies for Mains

papers.qualifying_threshold: Assesses personality, character, address, physique, leadership, and suitability for public service. Final selection based on Mains (800) + Interview (100) = 900 marks.

financial_package.note: State-jurisdiction cadre under Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017. Direct recruits to the Rajasthan Administrative Service (RAS) Junior Scale and Rajasthan Police Service (RPS) enter at Pay Matrix Level L-14 (pre-revised Grade Pay ₹5,400). Trainees undergo 2 years of probation on a fixed remuneration of ₹39,300 per month. On confirmation, regular basic pay starts at ₹56,100 plus DA, HRA, and state executive allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: RPSC Notification 13/2024-25 & Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2017 Schedule I (State Services Junior Scale)
financial_package.estimate_note: Regular monthly pay following 2-year probation (probation fixed stipend is ₹39,300/month). Computed at Level L-14 entry basic pay ₹56,100 with standard 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025), HRA of 9% (Z-class locations) to 18% (Jaipur/Jodhpur/Kota/Ajmer/Bikaner Y-class cities), conveyance and telephone allowances. In-hand reflects statutory deductions including GPF/NPS, State Insurance (SI), and Rajasthan Government Health Scheme (RGHS).
official_perks: Government executive bungalow / residential quarters (Type IV/Type V) at sub-divisional and district headquarters
Official government vehicle with dedicated driver for field inspections and executive duties
Comprehensive cashless medical healthcare under Rajasthan Government Health Scheme (RGHS) for officer and dependants
Personal administrative and security staff (orderly, steno, and security personnel)
Reimbursement of official telephone, mobile, and high-speed residential internet expenses
Restored Old Pension Scheme (OPS) retirement and family pension benefits under Rajasthan Civil Services Pension Rules
